T-2520 settled it through the camera: no stair of buildable risers and goings draws that run from a 0.6 m floor through the present solve; solved with the fence's base, the run needs the floor 1.3-1.6 m over the walk in about ten risers of 0.15-0.16 m, the eye 28-33 m out on the far walk of Prairie Avenue (rms 2.8-3.1 px). The print cannot split that between a higher floor and a fall in the yard (the hedge hides the house's foot); the sheet's '2BB' basement makes it the floor's height. The camera's re-solve, the raised floor and the ten risers are T-2523's; the fence re-read at the new scale is T-2524's

Entrance: a pale gabled shape over the door's south leaf, 686-757 px across and 622-650 px high, identified by T-2520 as a glazed transom over the leaves: the leaves' lights' own tone in a porch otherwise black, starting on the south jamb, on a dark bar over the head. Built as a 0.12 m bar and one light under a low gable, 0.17 m at the jambs and 0.39 m at the middle: rendered, its south slope lies within 1 px of the print's (631, 627 and 623 px at 700, 710 and 720 px), its foot and apex 4 px high, and the apex at the door's middle, 10 px north of the print's; the glass's dark north part (what it reflects) is not modelled

Fence: the print's caps flare out at their lower corners like a hood over the heart; the model's cap is a plain box a little broader than the shaft

Fence: south of the south pier the print shows a pale block to the frame's edge with a pale rail at about 918 px, not the bars and base north of the gateway; the model carries the barred run on to the lot line

South of the gable the print shows a two-storey block with a hipped roof, a pale stack and a two-light window over a door: the register's 'separate lower wing' or the neighbour, not yet identified; the model shows the gable range's south flank and projection there
Colour of every surface: the print is a monochrome halftone
